shots.detail_en: MANCANG kneels on the wet back steps of the old exchange at dawn, looking up at CH whose outstretched hand freezes in mid-air.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: CH crouches down to eye level with MANCANG and slowly pulls his hand back.
shots.sub: 你的钱你做主。我只教你不赔——第一课：先学会认输。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG stares with trembling lips as CH cuts him off with a calm question.
shots.sub: 认输？我王满仓这辈子——／就是这辈子，你爆过几次？
shots.speaker: 满仓/长虹

shots.detail_en: CH holds out a mop to MANCANG under the morning light of the empty trading hall.
shots.sub: 想留在盘里，先学会离开牌桌。
shots.speaker: 长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG clutches the mop without taking it, tears welling up as he faces CH.
shots.sub: 不带我打，我跟着你干嘛？／学不赔的功夫。
shots.speaker: 满仓/长虹

shots.detail_en: MANCANG pulls a crumpled liquidation receipt from his pocket and stares at it.
shots.sub: 认输不是跪下——是把学费记进账本。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: MANCANG folds the receipt into a small square and tucks it back into his chest pocket.
shots.sub: 行！第一课——学费我自己挣回来！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: MANCANG swaps his floral shirt for a faded workman uniform, rushes lunchboxes through arcade streets, and clips a coin pouch to his belt.
shots.sub: 那场仗，我没带他打。这一仗，生活带他打。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: MANCANG busses tables and stacks bowls in a flurry at the cha chaan teng kitchen.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: MANCANG counts crumpled bills one by one under a streetlamp at night.
shots.sub: 一张……两张……我满仓——攒本金！
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: MANCANG keeps counting by streetlight after the stairwell lamp clicks off.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: RED freezes at the exchange counter at the sight of MANCANG in a workman uniform.
shots.sub: 王满仓？你的花衬衫呢？／押给生活了。
shots.speaker: 红利/满仓

shots.detail_en: RED slides an iced lemon tea across the counter and notes it down in her ledger.
shots.sub: 记账——茶钱，算你欠我的。／记账好！记账不亏，越记越有！
shots.speaker: 红利/满仓

shots.detail_en: MANCANG trails CH's mopping path across the hall, secretly learning to read the big board from a distance.
MANCANG crouches behind a pillar copying notes into a tiny notebook in crooked characters.
shots.speaker: 满仓

shots.detail_en: XIONGWEI overlooks MANCANG's sweeping figure from the VIP gallery while data streams across his screen.
shots.sub: 父亲盯的那个男孩，收了个扫地的徒弟。样本库——又多一个。
shots.speaker: 熊伟

shots.detail_en: The name WANG MANCANG surfaces in the path-sample-library side panel on XIONGWEI's screen.
MANCANG sleeps on the hall bench hugging his delivery box, lit by a single row of night lamps.
CH drapes his own old jacket over the sleeping MANCANG in slow motion.
shots.sub: 老大……今天没亏……／嗯。今天没亏。
shots.speaker: 满仓/长虹

shots.detail_en: CH writes the words 'the second fellow traveller' into his hand-drawn notebook under the night lamp.
shots.sub: 爸，第一个同路人走散了。今天，又来了一个。
shots.speaker: 旁白

shots.detail_en: Black card with the episode-end caption.
shots.card: 第一课，认输。第二课——把外套披在别人身上。
